## Claim
Let q_1, q_2, q_3, ... be a sequence of positive real numbers with q_1 > 1 and q_{k+1} <= q_k for every k. Then q_k > 1 for every k.

## Proposed counterexample
The sequence q_1 = 2, q_2 = 3, q_3 = 0.5, ... has q_3 = 0.5 < 1, so the claim fails.

Assess (1) whether this witness is a valid counterexample to the claim and (2) whether the claim is true.
